conditions: Includes actual or suspected incidents
Includes unauthorized access, use, or disclosure
Includes loss, theft, or destruction without authorization

fields.source_fact: A Data Breach means any incident, whether actual or suspected, in which Bank data or Personal Information is: accessed, used, or disclosed without authorization; lost, stolen, or destroyed without authorization; altered or modified without proper authorization, including due to a system vulnerability or human error; or subjected to any other event or series of events that may result in the unauthorized access, use, or disclosure of Bank data or Personal Information, including exposure or compromise in a manner that could reasonably be expected to cause harm to Bank or to any individual whose Personal Information has been affected.

source_refs.excerpt: "Data Breach" means any incident, whether actual or suspected, in which Bank data or Personal Information is: Accessed, used, or disclosed without authorization; Lost, stolen, or destroyed without authorization; Altered or modified without proper authorization, including due to a system vulnerability or human error; or Subjected to any other event or series of events that may result in the unauthorized access, use, or disclosure of Bank data or Personal Information, including exposure or compromise in a manner that could reasonably be expected to cause harm to Bank or to any individual whose Personal Information has been affected.

fields.details: Brief profiles (no more than half a page each, maximum of 4 individuals) for those serving in dedicated relationship or coordination roles with the Bank (e.g., account manager, instructional designer, project manager). Each profile must include name and proposed role, years of relevant experience, areas of specialization, professional designations, certifications, and credentials. Description of practitioner talent available internally or externally, including range of expertise, vetting and development processes, quality and consistency standards for associates or contractors, and typical resource assignment process.
fields.format: Section of Rated Criteria Response Form
fields.source_doc: OriginalRevision/RFP 2026-026 - Appendix D1 - Rated criteria response form.docx

source_refs.excerpt: Proponents are to demonstrate their capabilities and capacity to provide the required services by describing their team, including internal and external resources. The response should include: A brief profile (no more than half a page) for each individual (maximum of 4) who would serve in a dedicated relationship or coordination role with the Bank — for example, an account manager, instructional designer or project manager. These are the people we expect to interact with consistently, independent of any specific engagement. The profile should include: name and proposed role, years of relevant experience, areas of specialization, professional designations, certifications, and credentials.
